name: Bartleby's Mug
summary: In Stormwind, Bartleby's Mug marks a young warrior's trial of grit. After besting Bartleby in the Pig and Whistle Tavern, you claim his drinking mug for your trainer, Harry Burlguard.

sections.title: Trophy of a Tavern Brawl
sections.body: Harry Burlguard tests young warriors with a brawl in Old Town. He asks you to take down Bartleby, a stubborn drunk at the bar of the Pig and Whistle Tavern. Once subdued, Bartleby reluctantly gives up his prized drinking mug, but first takes one final swig to drain the dregs.

sections.title: A Step Toward Mastery
sections.body: Returning the mug to Harry Burlguard completes your novice trial. Burlguard sees that you can persuade through sheer force and recognizes your readiness for defensive mastery. He points you onward to further battlefield instruction with Marshal Haggard, a seasoned veteran in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why does Harry Burlguard want Bartleby's mug?
faq.answer: Harry Burlguard wants Bartleby's mug as proof that you fought and bested him. Bartleby is fiercely attached to his drink, so giving up his personal mug shows he was soundly beaten into submission.
Bartleby is an unruly patron at the bar of the Pig and Whistle in Stormwind's Old Town. Drunken and foul-tempered, he gives local warrior trainers an informal test for up-and-coming fighters.

faq.q: Where does this fight take place?
faq.answer: The brawl takes place inside the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind's Old Town.

faq.q: What comes after returning the mug to Burlguard?
faq.answer: After Burlguard inspects the mug and confirms your victory, he teaches you advanced defensive combat stances. He then sends you outside the city gates to seek Marshal Haggard in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Does Bartleby get hurt permanently in the brawl?
faq.answer: No. The brawl is non-lethal. Bartleby yields, finishes his drink, hands over his mug, and remains in the tavern with bruises and wounded pride.

faq.q: Can any Alliance class do this quest?
faq.answer: Only Alliance warriors undertake this trial as part of their level ten class training in combat stances and defensive maneuvers.

angles.text: As a warrior in Stormwind, you prove you can stand toe-to-toe with unruly foes by taking Bartleby's mug.
As an Alliance member, you know disorderly patrons in Old Town are a familiar headache for Stormwind's martial instructors.
